notes.title: Roseblight v1.2.1.X Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41107111/37616fa80692abc7c598dc143fc95e085fc7bf2a.gif[/img]

This is a small content update that focuses on adding some scrapped ideas that were cut from the full release. This update adds:

- 4 alternate endings
- a small museum area with a good chunk of lore
- fishing!!
- a few other minor additions & changes

I initially planned on releasing this much earlier, but after the game's release, I lost a lot of motivation to continue working on it and lost even more after having to deal with some rather unpleasant experiences recently. I've received some... "feedback" from a few folks about how the game's story isn't up to par, so most of what I've added focuses on expanding the game's universe and provides more conclusions that take the story in a different direction. The main story hasn't changed, so hopefully what I've added will provide some new perspectives on what already exists and scratch a few itches that some people might have.

Full changelog is available in-game on the main menu. If you encounter any issues, please contact me using the info at the bottom of the changelog so they can be fixed. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Roseblight Steam Launch + v1.2.0.X Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41107111/1bdbfd170270c9057295755ea657f0509f248c43.png[/img]

First off, thank you for checking out Roseblight! It's not the best game in the world but I'm proud of it, and now it's pretty much finished (aside from a few inevitable bug fix patches and maybe some extra rooms or npcs sprinkled in). I might do more "bigger" content updates in the future if the game sort of does okay? Like there's still a few ideas I have but for now this is all there is to it.

[b]Roseblight v1.2.0.X - The Chained Souls update[/b] (aka the rest of the game) is the full game release, which includes the "other half" of the game along with some various gameplay changes and new content. Changelogs are available in-game if you would like to see specific changes.

If you encounter any bugs or errors during your playthrough please contact me so that I can fix them asap. Thank you guys for continuing to support the game, I really appreciate it.
